rules.R1: Declared prior to execution in analysis_plan.md Section 13 and variants_ledger.json; report all variants including failures.
rules.R2: Operational constraints: thread cap 4, one heavy retrieval process at a time, offline execution only, no modification of frozen Phase 0-6 results.
rules.R4: Neutral scientific tone: descriptive only, zero causal words.
rules.R5: Full reporting of all variants across 4-budget scaling curves; retain original O2 negative result as-is.

E1h.description: Structure-aware field chunking with header prepending ([<technique_id> <name> | <tactics>]), 150-token sentence-boundary splitting, and header repetition.
E1h.preprocessing: body-only queries via split_query; HD domain routing for cti-ate

E1h_div.description: E1h with diversity-constrained context packing admitting at most 2 chunks per technique ID before token budget truncation.

E1h_MIXED.description: Mixed-corpus version combining E1h technique chunks with baseline splitter chunks for groups and software.

statistical_testing.multiplicity: Holm step-down across declared P7 contrasts at family-wise alpha = 0.05 (M=4)
